observable_outcome: A fresh mini-versus-DeepSeek RAG attempt either emits an evidence-complete development verdict or stops at HOLD without making a model-quality claim, and writes per-case latency and answer-cost economics alongside quality movements.
non_goals: Use Luna as an answer arm
Let an autonomous agent own the verdict
Make economics alone force HOLD in this slice
examples: Each of 62 cases is retrieved once, then answered by both arms for exactly three repeats using identical contexts.

An empty answer that hits the harness max_tokens cap (harness_output_cap) receives zero scores and counts as one operational answer failure under the 2% answer-opportunity budget (ops/answers, never diluted by score opportunities); missing scores are gated separately at the same 2% of score opportunities; neither hard-HOLDs by itself below threshold. The 32k candidate cap is a harness cost control, not the model's published max output.
OpenRouter candidate actual_model attestation accepts only the dated canonical slug deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 (request may still use deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731).
Eval OpenRouter route policy pins only DeepInfra with reasoning.effort=low and allow_fallbacks=false.
Acceptance ledger status REVIEWED or INTEGRATED requires review_kind=cold_independent with no waiver language; operator waivers cap status at IMPLEMENTED.

Manual audit finalization requires gates.adversarial_review.status=PASSED with review_kind=cold_independent; a bare status=REVIEWED ledger (including historical waiver-era files) is rejected. ACCEPTED requires manual_calibration_passed=true from the blinded Luna audit.
A rejudge creates a child attempt and does not modify its parent.
A bounded semantic and provider-provenance canary must pass before the full answer matrix can spend.
task-economics.json reports per-arm mean latency_ms and cost_usd, and per-case three-repeat means with candidate-minus-baseline deltas, from answers.jsonl only.
OpenRouter chat completions finish first; /generation metadata is enriched afterward so the metadata store has time to index each generation id.
Live harness parallelism defaults: answer workers 8, Luna judge workers 8, freeze retrieval workers 8.
edge_and_failure_cases: zero rows or repeats other than three
missing, NaN, timed-out, or disagreeing judge results
empty, errored, truncated, output-ceiling, or metadata-incomplete answers
campaign or global spend reservation failure
gold answers containing literals removed by retrieval redaction
a review artifact that is stale, non-APPROVE, or bound to another commit
missing latency_ms or cost_usd on an answer row blocks economics rollup
independent_oracles: the complete frozen semantic eval case literals
literal judge-canary score bands for exact, contradictory, complete, partial, redacted, and PII-hallucinated answers
hand-computed three-repeat latency and cost means from frozen answer-row literals

acceptance_criteria.spend_reconciliation: canary, answer, and judge reservations are separate; overrun blocks later launch
